## Workload

Tomas Brennan completed grading work across the review period, reading 903 sets during 420 rostered hours. This represents an average throughput of 2.1 sets per hour. The workload was recorded against the available rostered time, providing a clear basis for considering both the volume completed and the pace of work.

## Quality

A sample of 78 sets was checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement level was 50.0 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistent interpretation and application of the grading approach. The review considered the checked work alongside the overall workload and throughput.

The review was completed by Priya Anand, with the workload and quality information considered together.
